Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Optional packed form owner with one byte Vec and one span Vec. Owned parse completes borrowed admission before reserving exact storage; append reserves bytes then spans with capped growth and publishes only after fallible work succeeds. Append errors preserve logical pairs/bytes but may change capacities and backing, so every prior borrow ends before each attempt; append inputs may not alias owned storage. Borrowed pair cursors implement Iterator/ExactSizeIterator. Owned encode uses the canonical form Encoding and alloc::io collector, releasing partial output and preserving the source. All nine library gates pass, including the 607-case independent model and six reached allocation denials with same-process recovery; four application groups/86 native cases also pass, with 20 reached denials separate; ownership/lifetimes and cleanup remain manual.
